version: opensandbox-server (uv tool, latest 2026-11) / egress v1.1.7 / execd v1.1.0 / python SDK 1.2.0

install.detail: uv + uv tool install opensandbox-server, Apache-2.0, bez uctu; 1 python server (~174 MB) + sidecar kontejner per sandbox; vyzaduje api_key a pristup k dockeru

headless.detail: REST/SDK bez TTY, server pod rootem pres sudo

adapter.detail: orchestrator/adapters/opensandbox.py funguje (rc, stderr, tar pres stdin = zapis pres files API + shell redirect); stdout jen jako textove radky, ne binarne; gateway pres per-task socat relay

cold_start.detail: create+prvni exec 3.7/3.73/3.75 s, median 3.73 s (s egress sidecarem a relayem); bez policy ~1-2 s; jednorazove 30 s stall

egress.detail: dns+nft: probe 14/14 blocked po workaroundech; defaultne ale nameserver z resolv.conf (LAN router) dosazitelny na vsech portech, IP-only policy nefiltruje DNS, pripojeni sidecaru do dalsi site obejde DNS filtr; gVisor + policy odmitnut serverem

credentials.detail: Credential Vault dns+nft e2e: FAKE-SECRET vlozen do hlavicky (HTTP i HTTPS) a substituce placeholderu v header/body; v sandboxu neni v env/proc/fs; placeholder na nevazany host neprojde substituovan; hosts musi byt FQDN

gateway.detail: LLM gw a squid dosazitelne pres relay (bridge je izolovan od factory-core); 403 unknown sandbox protoze map.conf neobsahuje IP relaye; identita = IP per-task relaye; /key/* 403

compose.detail: 0/15: Docker backend nema privileged/cap_add; runc: iptables Permission denied; gVisor runsc-dind: netfilter tabulky i bridge netlink nedostupne

isolation.detail: 3 sandboxy: vlastni /tmp, s policy se po siti nevidi ani nedosahnou hostitele; bez policy vidi sebe, hostitele (SSH), LAN a internet

lifecycle.detail: destroy uklidi vse; pause/resume funguje (0.05/0.07 s, stav prezije); snapshot na Docker 29 selhal (docker commit 404); 3 paralelni OK (4.4 s); vault je v pameti sidecaru

gvisor.detail: server odmitne networkPolicy s gVisorem; bez policy bezi (runsc, 200 na internet, otevreny)

kata_firecracker.detail: cteno: Firecracker jen pres Kubernetes Fast Sandbox, Kata vyzaduje registraci v daemon.json; nenainstalovano

verdict: Credential Vault s dns+nft funguje end-to-end a secret v sandboxu neni, ale egress ma nebezpecne defaulty (LAN nameserver otevreny, IP-only policy bez DNS filtru) a vyzaduje workaroundy, gateway jde jen pres relay. Docker Compose uvnitr nejde (zadny privileged, gVisor bez netfilter/bridge) a gVisor nejde s egress, takze pro nase PoC je to pouzitelne jen jako vault+egress vrstva bez compose.
